Why Homeowners Use Us Start with the problems that actually affect the quote Most bathroom projects start with uncertainty: is the shower leak cosmetic or structural, will the layout work, how much should be allowed for waterproofing, and what finish level is realistic? We help you get those questions into a clear order so the quote conversation is sharper from the start. Clear scope before anyone quotes We help Gold Coast homeowners turn leaks, dated tiles, cramped layouts and finish ideas into a sharper bathroom renovation brief. Waterproofing to AS 3740 Wet-area waterproofing is carried out to Australian Standard AS 3740 by licensed waterproofers, with aspect certification on completion. Written quotes before work starts Every project begins with a clear, itemised quote, and a written Domestic Building Contract for work over $3,300. Local Gold Coast focus From Southport to Coolangatta and the hinterland edge, the first questions account for local homes, access, humidity and apartment rules. Our Services Bathroom renovations Gold Coast: from rebuilds to tiling Whether you are gutting a tired family bathroom in Nerang, refitting a holiday-let ensuite in Surfers Paradise or sorting a leaking shower in Labrador, the right renovation plan covers every stage, from design and demolition through to tiling, waterproofing and final fit-off. Full Bathroom Renovations Full strip-out bathroom renovations for tired, leaking or impractical rooms, covering layout, waterproofing, tiling and fit-off. View service Small Bathroom Renovations Space-smart refits for compact bathrooms where storage, shower access and a cleaner layout matter more than extra floor area. View service Ensuite Renovations Ensuite upgrades that make the main bedroom work harder, from cramped shower rooms to calm double-vanity retreats. View service Shower Replacements & Upgrades Leaking or dated shower replacement with the membrane, drainage and screen details handled before fresh tiles go in. View service Bathroom Waterproofing Wet-area waterproofing to AS 3740 so the room is protected underneath the tiles, not just made to look new. View service Bathroom Tiling Bathroom tiling for floors, walls, niches and feature zones, set out for wet-area durability and a cleaner finished look. View service How It Works Four steps to your new bathroom From the first enquiry to handover, the process is built around clarity. There is no obligation when you request a quote, and your renovator sets out scope, price and terms in writing before any work begins. 1 Enquire Send the form with your suburb, rough budget and what you want changed about your bathroom. 2 Clarify the job We help draw out the room issues, access details and must-have outcomes so the site visit starts with useful information. 3 Written quote The renovator assesses your space and provides a clear, itemised quote, with a Domestic Building Contract for work over $3,300. 4 Renovate Once you approve the quote, the contractor schedules the work and manages every trade through to handover. Renovation costs and timelines vary widely with the size of the room, the quality of fittings and how much plumbing and electrical work is needed. Early figures are useful planning ranges only; the written quote follows the site review.
